title: fix(app-shell): gate MarketplacePackagePage's listLocalInstalls on marketplaceEnabled + isAdmin (#5620)
body:
Fixes #5620

## What

`MarketplacePackagePage`'s third fetch effect — `listLocalInstalls` — now checks
`marketplaceEnabled` and `isAdmin` in addition to (not instead of) its existing
`features.installLocal` check, matching the two predicates the page's other two fetch
effects (`getMarketplacePackage`, `getCloudInstallationInfo`) already check since
#5533/#5583.

```ts
useEffect(() => {
  if (!getRuntimeConfig().features.installLocal) return;
  if (!marketplaceEnabled) return;
  if (!isAdmin) return;
  ...
}, [packageId, localResult, marketplaceEnabled, isAdmin]);
```

## Why

`listLocalInstalls`'s only consumer is `localInstalls.find(...)` in the content branch
(line ~604), which is unreachable whenever the page has already returned
`MarketplaceDisabled` (`!marketplaceEnabled`, line 539) or `MarketplaceAccessDenied`
(`!isAdmin`, line 571) — both decided ahead of the content branch. Confirmed by reading:
`localInstalls` state has exactly one consumer in the file, at line 604, after all three
early returns.

Before this fix, a runtime with `features.installLocal: true` still fired the request —
and discarded its answer — on a marketplace-off runtime and for a refused (non-admin)
viewer. Same discipline #5533 established on this page ("a request the page knows it
will not use should be skipped rather than fired and discarded"), applied to the flag
that card wasn't about, per triage's shape.

`features.installLocal` stays its own axis — a genuinely separate deployment dimension —
so the fix is a conjunction, not a replacement.

## Premise check (per triage's premise-first clause)

Verified before editing: `localInstalls` (the state `listLocalInstalls`'s answer feeds)
has no consumer outside the content branch. No recorded ruling or external consumer
found that would pin the "fire unconditionally" reading. Proceeding with the gate as
specified.

## Tests

Added `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage-5620.test.tsx`,
following the mocking convention `MarketplacePackagePage.guardOrder.test.tsx` /
`*.disabledState.test.tsx` established (real `initRuntimeConfig()` over a stubbed
`GET /api/v1/runtime/config`, `t` echoing keys, `../marketplaceApi` module mock):

- marketplace off ⇒ `listLocalInstalls` never fires, even with `installLocal: true` and
  an admin viewer
- non-admin (refused) viewer on a marketplace-on runtime ⇒ never fires
- **positive control**: admin + marketplace on + `installLocal` on ⇒ fires, and its
  answer renders the local-install badge
- **negative control**: `installLocal: false` ⇒ still skips the request even for an
  admin on a marketplace-on runtime (pins that this axis is untouched)
- admin whose adminship resolves after first paint ⇒ fetches once the flag flips

19/19 tests pass across the new suite plus the two sibling suites it shares a page with
(no regression). `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell' type-check` — exit 0.
`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` — all dependency packages build clean.
Directed `eslint` on both touched files — 0 errors (pre-existing `no-explicit-any`
warnings at unrelated lines, untouched by this diff). Changeset gates
(`check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`) — all
pass.
